column1: "Engaging suppliers is key to reaching our net zero in 2030 goal. We have
worked to identify key suppliers, assess their climate maturity level and
integrate them into our decarbonization journey. In a dynamic technology
landscape, we are constantly adapting and learning to build a scalable
program. Close supplier partnerships and cross-industry collaborations are
key to creating a lasting GHG reduction plan."
HEAD OF NET ZERO SUPPLIER ENGAGEMENT PROGRAM
